module: Flowgraph node 'Stop Replay' (repeat_instant category). Stops the current playback: if core_replay.state.state is 'playback', calls core_replay.stop(). No pins.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (created by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Stops the replay if it is playing.
